description: This file defines the GraphiteSink class for integrating Spark metrics with Graphite. It manages configuration, initializes Graphite clients, and controls reporting intervals.

classes.name: GraphiteSink
classes.description: A sink for sending Spark metrics to Graphite, configurable via properties, supporting different protocols and filtering.

methods.name: propertyToOption
methods.description: Converts a property value to an Option[String], returning None if missing.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the Graphite reporter with configured polling period and unit.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Triggers a metrics report to Graphite.
